reports.title: McKESSON REPORTS FISCAL 2027 SECOND QUARTER RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Full Year Outlook
section: •Raised Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range to $45.60 to $46.40, from the previous range of $44.20 to $45.00.
•Fiscal 2027 Adjusted Earnings per Diluted Share guidance range indicates 17% to 19% growth compared to the prior year.
•The Company does not forecast GAAP earnings per diluted share1.

“McKesson delivered another quarter of strong results, reflecting operational strength in our core business segments and disciplined execution across the enterprise,” said Brian Tyler, chair and chief executive officer. “We continue to invest strategically to advance healthcare outcomes and create long-term value. We further strengthened our portfolio through transactions that will expand our capabilities and deepen our presence in key growth areas, while maintaining our commitment to financial discipline. We are confident in our ability to leverage differentiated solutions and create value for customers, partners, patients, and shareholders. As we close out a strong first half of our fiscal year, I want to thank Team McKesson for their unwavering commitment to excellence and for the impact they make across healthcare every day.”
